title: Xerxes invades Greece
summary: CFAH AP-13: the second Persian invasion of Greece under Xerxes (480 BC), told in Herodotus Books 7–9.
description: Added from the Herodotus import (The Histories, tr. Rawlinson). Sorted by the CFAH anchor point cited below; Herodotus entries are display only.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-13: Xerxes’ Invasion of Greece: 480 B.C."
chronologies.note: CFAH-3: 296 years after the First Olympiad (776 B.C.) gives "480 B.C. Xerxes invades Greece"; 704 years after the Fall of Troy (1183 B.C.) gives 479 B.C. "The Second Persian Invasion of Greece ended in June 479 B.C., about 15 months after it began."

chronologies.date: “Reckoning from the recovery of Egypt, Xerxes spent four full years in collecting his host”
chronologies.citation: Herodotus, Histories 7.20 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 439 (PDF p. 441)

chronologies.date: “It was not till the close of the fifth year that he set forth on his march”
chronologies.citation: Herodotus, Histories 7.20 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 439 (PDF p. 441)
chronologies.note: Agrees with CFAH AP-13 (480 BC) for the invasion, which this interval is counted towards.

chronologies.date: “having first wintered at Sardis, began its march towards Abydos, fully equipped, on the first approach of spring”
chronologies.citation: Herodotus, Histories 7.37 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 445 (PDF p. 447)
chronologies.note: At the departure "the sun suddenly quitted his seat in the heavens" (7.37); no astronomical date is attached here. Spring of the invasion year, 480 BC by CFAH AP-13.

chronologies.date: “a space of four months had gone by; one, while the army made the crossing, and delayed about the region of the Hellespont; and three while they proceeded thence to Attica, which they entered in the archonship of Calliades”
chronologies.citation: Herodotus, Histories 8.51 (tr. George Rawlinson; Roman Roads Media etext, 2013), p. 536 (PDF p. 538)
chronologies.note: Herodotus dates by the Athenian archon; he does not number the year. Within CFAH AP-13 (480 BC).
